findings.english: Lines per file (up to two are read)
findings.current: प्रति फ़ाइल पंक्तियाँ (अधिकतम दो पढ़ी जाती हैं)
findings.problem: Meaning changed. In English "up to two" means FILES (the daemon log and the runtime log). The Hindi "अधिकतम दो पढ़ी जाती हैं" agrees in the feminine plural with पंक्तियाँ, so it reads "at most two LINES are read". That misstates what the flag does: a user would think --lines is capped at 2.
findings.suggested: "प्रति फ़ाइल पंक्तियाँ (अधिकतम दो फ़ाइलें पढ़ी जाती हैं)"
